title: Cluster model construction
action: Cut a 46T finite cluster from the MFI crystallographic structure around the T12 Brønsted acid site, terminate with hydrogen atoms, and apply constraints to peripheral hydrogens to prevent unphysical deformation.

title: Geometry optimization and transition state search
action: Optimize geometries for all reactants, products, and transition states of reactions A2 (n-propoxide formation), A5 (stepwise propene dimerization to 2-hexyl carbenium ion), and B1 (cyclization to methylcyclopentane) using ONIOM(B3LYP/6-31+g(d):MNDO) on the 46T cluster. Perform harmonic frequency analysis to confirm minima (no imaginary frequencies) and transition states (exactly one imaginary frequency).

title: Single-point energy refinement
action: At each optimized geometry, compute single-point electronic energies using the higher-level ONIOM(B3LYP/6-31+g(d):HF/6-31+g(d)) method.

title: DFT-D dispersion correction
action: Add the Grimme DFT-D empirical dispersion correction to the single-point energies from step s2. This yields the final dispersion-corrected electronic energies for all stationary points.

title: Extract barriers, reaction energies, and rate constants
action: From the dispersion-corrected energies and harmonic frequencies, calculate the electronic activation barrier ΔE‡ and reaction energy ΔEr for each elementary step (A2, A5, B1). Additionally, compute forward and backward rate constants (in s⁻¹) at 673 K using transition state theory (TST) with the obtained frequencies. Write all twelve values to energies.json.
description: Dispersion-corrected electronic energy barriers, reaction energies, and TST rate constants at 673 K for the n-propoxide formation (A2), stepwise propene dimerization (A5), and cyclization to methylcyclopentane (B1) in H-ZSM-5.
output_schema: JSON object with twelve keys: A2_E_barrier, A2_E_reaction, A5_E_barrier, A5_E_reaction, B1_E_barrier, B1_E_reaction (floats, kJ/mol); A2_k_forward, A2_k_backward, A5_k_forward, A5_k_backward, B1_k_forward, B1_k_backward (floats, s⁻¹).
